We extend our heartiest congratulations to  Mr. Pakshal Secretry , who secured AIR – 8 in UPSC CSE 2025. We are honored to have been a part of his remarkable journey to success.

Courses joined at NEXT IAS
Essay Guidance
Test Series
Interview Guidance Program (IGP)

This outstanding achievement reflects your dedication, perseverance, and relentless hard work. Wishing you continued success as you embark on your journey of public service and leadership.

🎥 Watch the Exclusive Mock Interview of a UPSC CSE 2025 Rank Holder conducted under the Interview Guidance Program (IGP) by NEXT IAS. This session closely mirrors the actual UPSC Personality Test, offering aspirants a clear understanding of the interview process, expected thought process, communication style, and overall personality assessment.

📌 A valuable session for every UPSC aspirant preparing for the Civil Services Interview.

🔔 Subscribe to NEXT IAS for more topper interviews, preparation strategies, and UPSC guidance.
